verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm API access to an account's transaction history, and a webhook fires when a transaction refresh completes, which supports a basic refresh-then-fetch sync loop. History depth appears only in a community comment (up to 180 days, daily pulls), and no first-party documentation covers pagination or fetching only changed transactions. Missing for 10: documented pagination, first-party history-depth documentation, documented incremental/changed-only sync, hands-on corroboration of the transactions API.
